0022600230.text: The Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road) visit the Suns (4-6, 4-3 at home) on a one-game win streak, sitting 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, while Phoenix is 11th in the West and also riding a W1 streak. Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate is day-to-day with a quadriceps injury and a game-time decision, while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with the Hornets winning the last meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
